content.text: March 22, 2026, 5:08 a.m. ETST. LOUIS — Kentucky basketball escaped in overtime of its NCAA Tournament opener, squeezing past Santa Clara, 89-84, on Friday.One more victory is all that separates the Wildcats and coach Mark Pope from their second straight Sweet 16 appearance. To get there, seventh-seeded UK will have to knock out the Midwest Region's No. 2 seed, IowaState. Though the Cyclones are slight favorites, per oddsmakers, the Cats should have one factor in their favor.Iowa State's best player, forward Joshua Jefferson, is "unlikely" to take the court, per coach T.J. Otzelberger.An All-American selection this season, Jefferson is one of the country's best players. But he injured his ankle in the team's first-round rout of Tennessee State.Watch select 2026 NCAA Tournament games live with Fubo (free trial)Kentucky and Iowa State have squared off three times, with the Wildcats winning every matchup. All three meetings have occurred in the Big Dance, with the most recent an 87-71 UK win in Louisville in 2012.
